Report from mPING: Street/road flooding.

Report from mPING: Street/road flooding.
Low spot on 5th Avenue underneath the railroad tracks has flooded to a depth of several feet.
Keith at Sanderson flooded roadway with report of stalled vehicle.
Building at Central and Broadway taking on water through front doors.
Third Creek at Hinton_ flooded intersection with floodwaters up to at least knee depth.
Intersection on Middlebrook Pike with minor flooding_ no vehicles stranded but small vehicles may be unable to pass through.
Dispatch reported numerous downed trees.
Multiple trees reported down.
Numerous trees down across Hamilton County.
Several reports of trees down mainly in southern part of Bradley County.
Several reports of trees and powerlines down.
911 call center reports 1 tree down along Owl Creek Rd.
911 Call Center reports 1 tree down along Hendrix Rd.
Several trees down between Dungannon and Nickelsville.
One structure evacuated due to flooding.
Several roads closed in the Appalachia and Big Stone Gap area due to flooding.
Tree(s) reported down on Campbell St. Timing based on radar.
Tree down along Hughes Rd. Time estimated by radar.
Tree down along Sequatchie Mtn Rd. Time estimated by radar.
Power lines down at Moccasin Bend Golf Course. Time estimated by radar.
At least 3 homes with trees fallen on top_ multiple trees down blocking or partially blocking roadways_ powerlines down_ with strong concentration in Chattanooga. A few trees down in Hixson.
Multiple trees down on Birchwood Pike (Hwy 312) between Hwy 58 and Hwy 60. Time estimated by radar.
Tree down at Cummings HWY near the Walmart Tree down at River George Drive in BlackCreek Subdivision.
Trees down at intersection of Signal Mt Rd and Pinevill Rd_ law enforcement on scene_ trees being cleared away.
Multiple down tree reports on north side of the county. Time estimated by radar.
Tree(s) down along Greasy Creek Rd. Time estimated by radar.
Tree(s) down along Highway 30. Time estimated by radar.
Tree(s) down along Highway 68. Time estimated by radar.
Trained spotter passed along power outages in three locations_ two clusters in Polk County_ one in western Cherokee County. Power Outage website notes over 2000 customers without power in Polk_ 1300
Flooding reported at Oakland Ave and Lakeview Dr_ and at Princeton Rd and Austin Springs Rd.
High water reported at Karns Underpass near Ball Camp Byington Rd and Byington Solway Rd.
THP report of about 3 feet of running water near N Cedar Bluff Rd and Executive Park Dr.
Roadway flooded near Lockett Rd and Deane Hill Dr.
Roadway flooded on Downtown W Blvd just north of Gleason Dr NW.
Moderate flooding in back yard_ several inches deep. Water is covering the foundation of several outdoor buildings.
Water over roadway on Shawnee Drive.
Roberts Lane at Ivy Dale Road washed out.
Water flowing over Shipe Road in Corryton with at least 15 feet of the roadway covered by a couple inches of quick flowing water.
County dispatch reports multiple flooded roadways south and east of Huntsville_ with waters still rising.
Several inches of standing water flooding the front yard in front of a home in Andersonville. Road is not covered by water_ but water is near/next to the pictured home.
Creekside Ridge Subdivision in Dandridge - street flooding. Roadbed not visible.
Road is starting to flood Thompson School Road at Emory Road.
Jefferson County evacuated a family from a home on Piedmont Road west of SR-92. Pictures show water flowing past home right up to the home though doesnt appear at the time to have water in the reside
Street flooding near Plum Creek Park with one or two inches of water flowing/pooling on the road surface.
Basement and garage are sitting in several inches of water_ resident of 10 years and never seen water this high.
One lane closed on Veterans Blvd near the DigN zone theme park due to flood issues.
Multiple roads in Anderson flooded/impassable. Small land slide on 116 near Briceville. Seivers blvd @ i75 flooded. Indian fork Road in Norris has 2-3 feet of swift water.
Edington at Maryville Pike report of road being flooded yet cars are still attempting to power through. Unknown depth.
Gists Creek Road partially flooded with standing water pooling over the roadway.
County official reports stormwater drainage mainly being overwhelmed and a few small streams as well. Flood issues primarily water flowing over a few local county roads.
Report of mudslide in Campbell County near Morley Mountain. Time of slide uncertain. Picture shows debris covering both lanes of roadway with several feet of rock and mud on the lane closest to slide
Multiple reports via social media of quarter-sized hail in the Cassi community just southeast of Liberty_ TN.
Areas of trees and powerlines down in the Tusculum to Limestone area due to thunderstorm winds.
